passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nThe psalm is for the choirmaster.\r\nDavid gave this psalm to be sung.

passages.text: O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm of David.
David is the author.
The king is the subject.
The king feels joy because of the LORD’s strength.
The king rejoices in God’s power.
The king celebrates God’s salvation.
The king exults greatly because God saves him.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּעָזְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמַח־ מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ֝בִישׁ֥וּעָתְךָ֗ מַה־ מְאֹֽד׃ יָּ֥גֶיל

passages.text: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
passages.sermon:
David is the king.
God gave David what his heart desired.
God did not refuse what David asked for.
God gave David many good blessings.
God put a pure gold crown on David’s head.
passages.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת לִ֭בּוֹ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ וַאֲרֶ֥שֶׁת שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו בַּל־ מָנַ֥עְתָּ סֶּֽלָה׃ כִּֽי־ תְ֭קַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכ֣וֹת ט֑וֹב תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ עֲטֶ֣רֶת פָּֽז׃

passages.text: He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.
passages.sermon:
David is the king.
David asked God for life.
God gave life to David.
God gave David many days.
God gave David days that last forever.
passages.original: חַיִּ֤ים׀ שָׁאַ֣ל מִ֭מְּךָ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ אֹ֥רֶךְ יָ֝מִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

passages.text: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
passages.sermon:
God saves the king.
God gives the king great glory.
God gives the king splendor.
God gives the king majesty.
passages.original: גָּד֣וֹל כְּ֭בוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ ה֥וֹד וְ֝הָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
passages.sermon: God gives the king blessings that last forever.\r\nGod fills the king with joy.\r\nGod brings this joy by allowing the king to be in His presence.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ תְשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָעַ֑ד תְּחַדֵּ֥הוּ בְ֝שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת־ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
passages.sermon:
The king trusts in the LORD.
The king relies on the LORD’s faithfulness.
The Most High shows loving devotion.
Because of this, the king stands firm.
The king will not be shaken.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל־ יִמּֽוֹט׃

passages.text: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God acts with power and authority.
God’s hand will find every enemy.
God’s right hand will seize all who hate Him.
passages.original: תִּמְצָ֣א יָ֭דְךָ לְכָל־ אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יְ֝מִֽינְךָ תִּמְצָ֥א שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful and just.
The LORD appears at a chosen time.
At that time, the LORD acts against His enemies.
The LORD places His enemies in a fiery furnace.
The LORD shows His wrath.
The LORD engulfs His enemies in His anger.
Fire consumes the enemies of the LORD.
passages.original: תְּשִׁיתֵ֤מוֹ׀ כְּתַנּ֥וּר אֵשׁ֮ לְעֵ֪ת פָּ֫נֶ֥יךָ יְ֭הוָה בְּאַפּ֣וֹ יְבַלְּעֵ֑ם וְֽתֹאכְלֵ֥ם אֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
passages.sermon: God acts with power against His enemies.\r\nGod will remove their descendants from the earth.\r\nGod will erase their offspring from among all people.
passages.original: פִּ֭רְיָמוֹ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּאַבֵּ֑ד וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks to the LORD.
Some people plan to harm the LORD.
They think of evil against Him.
They make secret plans.
Their plans will not succeed.
Their schemes will fail.
passages.original: כִּי־ נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה בַּל־ יוּכָֽלוּ׃

passages.text: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power.
God causes His enemies to flee.
God aims His bow at them.
God drives them away.
passages.original: כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם בְּ֝מֵֽיתָרֶ֗יךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is strong.
The LORD deserves to be lifted high.
We will sing to the LORD.
We will praise the LORD’s power.
passages.original: ר֣וּמָה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעֻזֶּ֑ךָ נָשִׁ֥ירָה וּֽ֝נְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃
